rule.eligibility: STEP 16 E1-E5 + A1-A3 verbatim (select_step16_cohort.evaluate; audit eligibleCount re-verified)
rule.frameRule: every UTC day of [t0 - 1 d, t0 + 72 h + 1 d] COMPLETE (00,03,06,09,12,15,18,21Z) in the time-axis inventory; nearest / interpolated / substituted / reconstructed frames never count
rule.accumulation: one chronological sequence over all regions; a window enters only if it contributes >= 1 drifter ID absent from every prior cohort and from the accumulated cohort; selected starts in the same region >= 72 h apart; stop at targetWindows or exhaustion; no balancing; no performance input; no manual choice
rule.primaryCohort: shortest chronological prefix reaching >= 6 windows and >= 20 drifters; order never changed
rule.exclusion: all STEP 20 calibration and holdout IDs, all 32 STEP 32 IDs, all STEP 20 and STEP 32 window starts (+-72 h)
